Regeneration tolerance table (per species)

Source: R/indice_priorite_regen.R
regeneration_tolerances.Rd

Per-species heat / dryness tolerance thresholds used by the optional species tuning of indice_priorite_regen (spec 027 §10.1). Read from inst/extdata/regeneration_tolerances.csv. Values are indicative (they order species sensitivity), keyed on list_species_classes; documented, not field-calibrated (spec 027 §9.2).

Usage

regeneration_tolerances()

Value

A data.frame with columns code, label, tmax_tol_c (max tolerated under-canopy summer T°max, °C) and vpd_tol_kpa (max tolerated summer VPD, kPa).

See also

indice_priorite_regen, list_species_classes
